title: The Singularity Has a Distribution: Exact Timing Laws and Detection Limits for a Stochastic Intelligence Explosion
abstract: arXiv:2610.18445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automating AI research creates a positive feedback loop between software capability and research effort. We study a stochastic realisation of this loop in which independent, positive, multiplicative improvements arrive at a rate proportional to a power of current capability. Within this model, randomness leaves the deterministic explosion threshold unchanged but replaces the blow-up date by an explicit distribution. For equal-sized improvements the explosion time is a geometrically weighted sum of independent exponentials; its $q$-series representation gives its transforms, moments and tail behaviour, including a two-term small-time asymptotic. For Lomax-distributed improvement sizes the explosion time is exactly Gamma distributed. Self-similarity implies that, with parameters known, the relative uncertainty about the remaining time does not vanish as explosion approaches. We formulate a fixed-sample test between constant and geometrical

translated_title: 奇点有一个分布：随机智能爆炸的精确时间定律与检测极限
translated_abstract: 自动化AI研究在软件能力与研究投入之间形成了一个正反馈循环。我们研究了该循环的一个随机实现，其中独立、正的乘性改进以与当前能力的某个幂成正比的速率到达。在该模型中，随机性不会改变确定性爆炸的阈值，但会将爆炸日期替换为一个显式的概率分布。对于等大小的改进，爆炸时间是独立指数随机变量的几何加权之和；其 q-级数表示给出了该分布的变换、矩与尾部行为，包括两项小时间渐近。对于服从Lomax分布的改进大小，爆炸时间精确地服从Gamma分布。自相似性意味着，在参数已知的情况下，随着爆炸的临近，对剩余时间的相对不确定性并不会消失。我们构建了一个固定样本检验，用于区分常数型与几何型（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文将智能爆炸建模为随机过程，首次推导出奇点到来时间的精确概率分布（等大小改进时为几何加权指数和、Lomax改进大小下严格为Gamma分布），并证明即使参数已知，爆炸临近时剩余时间的相对不确定性也不会消失。
en_tdlr: This paper models the intelligence explosion stochastically and derives exact probability distributions for the singularity's timing, showing that randomness preserves the deterministic explosion threshold but turns the blow-up date into an explicit distribution whose relative uncertainty never vanishes as the explosion approaches.
